knowledge_gaps: The combined proposal cannot establish whether gains come from the residual or BPR-max. Specify baseline, residual-only, BPR-max-only and combined ablations, including their allocation within the shared GPU budget. Originality and potential ratings remain subjective.

The residual is described as bounded, but a sigmoid gate only bounds its multiplier; the projected residual can grow without bound. Specify normalization, projection dimensions, gate initialization and regularization.

History-filtered negative sampling requires user identities, but the documented diagnostic loader returns None in that field. Explain how the training sampler retains user identity, handles repeated negatives and dense histories, and avoids using validation/test interactions.

The proposal omits baseline optimizer settings, batch size, checkpoint-selection cadence and tie-breaking. Materializing 32 negatives for every valid sequence position also needs a memory/runtime estimate.

Training-position margins and feedback from twenty simulator users do not establish improved held-out ranking or current-intent understanding. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting; mean cosine similarity near zero also cannot rule out other forms of embedding degeneration.
